Drink in Amsterdam this week

All this week's events

23 – 29 Nov · 8 events

Wine and beer tastings, pop-up bars, brewery and distillery events and other drinks nights that only run for a short time. A good fit for curious drinkers and groups of friends who want an evening out beyond their usual bar. The list is updated every week. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

Showing today onwards

  1. Winter Market Leidseplein

    Christmas Markets · Markets · Food · Drink

    When
    Daily, Mon 23 – Sun 29 Nov (runs until 3 Jan), Mon–Fri 12:00–23:00; Sat & Sun 11:00–23:00
    Where

    Price
    Free entry; pay per stall
    Organiser
